name: right-size
description: Picks model and effort per prompt with a quick Haiku judge; shows the pick as one status line.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: model-and-effort changes the model and the effort per prompt. effort-only keeps your session's model and changes only the effort, so the prompt cache is never lost.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long a model's prompt cache counts as hot after its last request. 60 for Claude Code subscriptions; 5 if your account uses the API's default cache.

smallContextTokens.title: Small chat size (tokens)
smallContextTokens.description: Below this context size, switching models is always allowed: re-reading the chat on another model is cheap.
